verdict.rationale: Typesense is open source and can run locally or on any server, and users push their own data into it, so self-hosters keep full custody over where data lives and how long it is kept. However, the pack never documents an actual deletion API, retention policy, TTL, or data-deletion terms for Typesense Cloud, so control over deletion is only implied. Missing for 10: documented document/collection deletion APIs, retention/TTL controls, Cloud data-deletion and retention policy, independent corroboration.
